how.title: From booking to paying, in four steps

steps.title: Book a Sipalu, or post a Kaam request
steps.body: Pick a person and a time with the price shown up front — or describe the job and get up to three offers within a day.

steps.title: The Sipalu accepts
steps.body: Until they do, their phone and your exact address stay hidden. If they don't answer in time, the request lapses and you can book someone else.

steps.title: Read out your arrival code at the door
steps.body: Your app shows a four-digit code. The Sipalu enters it when they arrive, so you know it is the person you booked.

steps.title: Pay them directly, then rate each other
steps.body: Cash, eSewa, Khalti or bank — straight to the Sipalu. KaamSathi never holds their money.

safety.title: If something feels wrong
safety.body: Every booking has a confidential “Report a problem” button. Our team reads safety reports first.
safety.emergency: In an emergency, call Nepal Police on 100.

request_cta.title: Not sure who to call?
request_cta.body: Post a Kaam request with up to four photos. Up to three verified Sipalu nearby can send you an offer within a day.

join_cta.title: Are you a Sipalu?
join_cta.body: Make your own profile with your skills, areas and price. Households book you directly. You keep everything they pay.

join.title: Your skill, your price. KaamSathi never takes a cut from you.
join.body: Make a Sipalu profile with your trades, areas, days and prices. Households book you and pay you directly.
points: No joining fee, no commission, no deduction — ever.
You set your price, your areas and your working days.
Every finished job and rating adds to your Skill Passport.

business.title: Hiring for a hotel, a site or a factory?
business.body: The same verified people, hired for longer: KaamSathi shortlists verified workers, runs hajiri on any phone and works out payroll the way Nepal's labour law asks.
points: Verified workers shortlisted by trade, district and experience
Hajiri from the supervisor's phone, even without internet
Wage sheet with minimum wage, SSF, overtime and Dashain allowance
